subject: ইংরেজি লিখিত
question: Draft an official 'Cure Notice / Penalty Warning Letter' from the Department of Immigration and Passports to the authorized Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) vendor for repeated failure to replace degraded UPS battery banks within the agreed SLA timeframe.
answer:
Model Contractual Cure Notice:

GOVERNMENT OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF BANGLADESH
DEPARTMENT OF IMMIGRATION AND PASSPORTS
OFFICE OF THE SYSTEM ANALYST
E-7 Agargaon, Dhaka-1207

Ref: 44.01.0000.301.08.004.26-789
Date: 23 October 2026

To:
The Managing Director
ElectroTech Power Solutions Ltd.
House-14, Road-07, Banani, Dhaka-1213.

SUBJECT: FORMAL CURE NOTICE: PERSISTENT DELAY IN REPLACING FAULTY 10 KVA ONLINE UPS BATTERY BANKS UNDER AMC CONTRACT NO: DIP/AMC-UPS/2025-26

Dear Sir,

This serves as a formal written notice regarding your repeated breach of performance commitments under the active Annual Maintenance Contract (Contract Ref: DIP/AMC-UPS/2025-26, dated 15 January 2026).

2. As per Clause 8.2 (Service Level Agreement) of the said contract, your technical personnel are contractually obligated to rectify or replace defective UPS battery cells within twenty-four (24) hours of ticket issuance. However, Ticket #UPS-DH-402 (issued on 12 October 2026) and Ticket #UPS-CTG-409 (issued on 16 October 2026) regarding swollen and degraded 12V 100Ah VRLA battery strings remain unaddressed despite three formal reminders.

3. This prolonged negligence has deprived our production passport servers of clean redundant power, exposing national immigration databases to severe risks of catastrophic power surges and unbudgeted downtime.

4. You are hereby called upon to **cure this default within forty-eight (48) hours** of receipt of this notice by delivering and commissioning genuine replacement battery modules. Failure to comply will compel this Department to invoke Clause 14.1, imposing liquidated damages at 0.5% per week of the contract value and initiating forfeiture of your Performance Guarantee Security, alongside prospective blacklisting from future public tenders.

Please treat this notice as extremely urgent.

Yours faithfully,

(Signature)
(Engr. Kazi Mahfuzur Rahman)
System Analyst & Head of Maintenance
Department of Immigration and Passports
Email: sysanalyst@dip.gov.bd
points_to_remember: A legal/contractual cure notice must cite specific contract clauses, dates, ticket IDs, and exact legal remedies/penalties.
